holidays.name: New Year Dawn
holidays.description: A quiet solemn gathering marking another year surviving against the odds in the underground refuge.

holidays.name: Spring Thaw Gathering
holidays.description: Observing the first meltwater dripping down the ventilation intakes, symbolizing renewed hope.

holidays.name: Midsummer Long Day
holidays.description: Celebrating the longest solar cycle with ration delicacies and shared music in the common room.

holidays.name: Wasteland Harvest Observance
holidays.description: Honoring the hydroponic yields and preserved stocks before the bitter permafrost locks the earth.

holidays.name: Winter Solstice Vigil
holidays.description: Keeping torches and lamps lit through the darkest 24 hours of the year to affirm shelter solidarity.

anniversary_types.name: Shelter Founding Day
anniversary_types.description: Commemorating the initial sealing of the blast doors and preservation of the community.

anniversary_types.name: Remembrance of the Fallen
anniversary_types.description: Lighting memorial candles for companions lost to the wasteland, providing closure and shared sorrow.

anniversary_types.name: Survival Milestone
anniversary_types.description: Honoring hundred-day survival thresholds achieved by the bunker.
